about.title: South Gate Car Accident Claims
about.longDescription: Firestone Boulevard carries a great deal of South Gate's daily life, and it appears frequently in the city's public collision records, alongside Southern Avenue, Imperial Highway and Garfield Avenue. In 2025, South Gate logged 419 injury collisions. Those crashes left 597 people hurt and claimed 6 lives, in a city of roughly 96,000 residents. Reports tend to cluster on Friday evenings between 6 and 8 p.m., when commuter and weekend traffic overlap. If one of those collisions involved you, the days that follow can feel disorganized: a car that may not be drivable, doctor visits, and an adjuster from the other driver's insurer already calling. LawProactive exists to take one task off your list. We are not a law firm. We are a free service that pairs you with an independent personal injury attorney who handles car accident claims in Los Angeles County and works on contingency. You describe what happened; we make the connection. The attorney then reviews your options under California law, including the two-year filing window and how comparative fault might apply to your situation.

whyChoose.title: Why South Gate Drivers Turn to LawProactive

items.title: The clock is already running
items.desc: California gives most car accident victims two years to file a lawsuit, but claims involving a government vehicle or a public roadway defect can require notice in as little as six months. Getting connected early means those deadlines are tracked from the start.

items.title: Partial blame does not close the door
items.desc: Under California's pure comparative fault rule, you can still pursue compensation even if you shared some responsibility for the crash; your recovery is simply reduced by your percentage of fault. An attorney can push back when an insurer tries to overstate your share.

items.title: No fee unless you recover
items.desc: Every attorney in our network works on contingency, so there is nothing to pay upfront and nothing owed if there is no recovery. Our connection service costs you nothing as well.

items.question: The other driver's insurance company wants a recorded statement about my crash on Firestone Boulevard. Should I give one?
items.answer: You are generally not required to give a recorded statement to the other driver's insurer, and it is usually wise to speak with an attorney first. Adjusters may ask questions designed to shift fault toward you, which matters under California's comparative fault system. In the meantime, keep photos of the scene, the vehicles, and any traffic camera or business locations near the intersection, and hold on to the police report number.

items.question: How long do I have to file a car accident claim in South Gate?
items.answer: For most car accident injury claims in California, the statute of limitations is two years from the date of the crash. If a city, county or state vehicle was involved, or you believe a road condition contributed, a government claim may need to be filed within six months. Because these deadlines are strict, it helps to have an attorney confirm which one applies to you.

items.question: Is there a limit on what I can recover for pain and suffering after a South Gate car accident?
items.answer: California does not cap non-economic damages, such as pain and suffering, in ordinary car accident cases. Your recovery depends on the specific facts, including your injuries, medical treatment, lost income and any share of fault assigned to you. No attorney can promise a particular result, but one can explain how these factors are likely to shape your claim.
